title: Issue with SMB using xDrip BG broadcasts from G7 sensor following the latest xDrip nightly
body:
AAPS no longer accepts the transmitted BG values for SMBs (Safety warning in AAPS/SMB: SMB always and after carbs disabled because active BG source doesn't support advanced filtering), after having updated xDrip+ to the latest nightly (https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2024.01.05)

Used software/devices
- AAPS v3.2.0.3 (BG source: xDrip+)
- xDrip+ (as CGM collector)
- Pixel 5
- CGM Dexcom G7 

It looks like the new xDrip broadcast identifier (G7) is the culprit (not identified by AAPS as a reliable BG source), see https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3278.
